task.title: Define production quality profile
task.summary: Create a policy-backed quality profile for implementation/task-close promotion using deterministic checks, review thresholds, content proof, and explicit waivers.

goal.outcome: Implementation and task-close gates can require a consistent production-ready quality profile with explicit evidence or waivers.
acceptance: Quality profile defines required checks/audits by change class and risk tier, including typecheck, tests, package/pack checks, review-tool findings, content proof, and drift audits where applicable.
Validation integration blocks promotion when required checks, thresholds, content proof, or fresh validation evidence are missing, unless an explicit waiver is recorded with rationale and owner.
Implementation builds can map acceptance criteria to quality evidence and remaining risk/waiver records.
Tests cover pass, missing-evidence block, waiver-required block/pass, and package/readiness scenarios.
non_goals: Do not require all review findings to be zero immediately; use thresholds or explicit waivers.
Do not replace existing task-specific verification criteria.
Do not perform publication or release.

delta.desired: Promotion/closure has deterministic quality evidence requirements and explicit waiver handling.
delta.current: Quality checks exist across tasks and audits but there is no unified production-ready gate profile.
delta.closure: Task closes when quality profile tests prove required evidence and waivers are enforced.
